title: Triangular cutoff threshold for the inversion walk on tournaments and the state space of restricted inversions
summary: Given a labelled tournament on $[n]$, \emph{inverting} a vertex subset $X$ means reversing every edge with both endpoints in $X$. Alon, Powierski, Savery, Scott, and Wilmer~\cite{AlonPowierskiSaveryScottWilmer2024} asked for the mixing time of the Markov chain that repeatedly inverts a uniformly random subset of $[n]$. We show that this \emph{inversion walk} has a triangular cutoff threshold. Let $T(s):=\binom{s+1}{2}$.
